suspicious_tlds.description: Top-level domains commonly associated with phishing and abuse (global coverage)

compound_tlds.description: Known compound TLDs (two-part public suffixes) for correct registrable domain extraction. Without this, .com.cn domains would extract 'com' instead of the actual domain label. Covers CN/TW/HK/UK/JP/AU/SG/KR/BR/IN/NZ/MX/ZA/RU and major EMEA/LATAM regions.

brand_anchor_domains.description: Brand keyword to legitimate domain mapping for DNS NS comparison. If a domain contains the keyword but its NS differs from the anchor domain NS, it is suspicious. Covers CN/JP/KR/RU/EU/LATAM/ME major brands.

shared_dns_providers.description: DNS registrar/provider domains whose NS records are shared by many unrelated domains, so NS match alone does not prove brand affiliation

free_hosting_domains.description: Free web hosting, PaaS, tunneling, and dynamic DNS domains commonly abused for phishing

redirect_service_domains.description: Known ad tracking and email redirect service domains. The outer URL is legitimate but the embedded target URL needs analysis.

opaque_mail_callback_domains.description: Known mail-platform callback domains that carry opaque encrypted tracking tokens rather than user-facing landing-page paths.

known_numeric_domains.description: Well-known domains that are purely numeric (not suspicious despite numeric pattern). Mostly Chinese platforms.

pinyin_syllables.description: Chinese pinyin syllable table for distinguishing legitimate pinyin domains from DGA-generated random strings

common_en_words.description: Common short English words used for username validation and DGA false positive reduction

benign_brand_domain_labels.description: Legitimate vendor/product labels that look consonant-heavy but are NOT DGA domains. Includes major CN/JP/KR/RU/EU/SaaS brands.

suspicious_user_agents.description: Suspicious HTTP user-agent strings indicating automated/scripted email sending

display_name_impersonation_targets.description: Brand names checked in display name vs sender domain mismatch detection (global brands across CN/JP/KR/RU/EU/LATAM/ME)

mail_security_gateways.description: Email security gateway URL rewrite domains. URLs from these domains should be unwrapped to analyze the embedded target URL.
